# Faster leveling, Max XP buffs, tips for double XP weekends or the game board

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_6_nukaknights-post-xp-farming.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

### Content:

Everyone wants to level up faster every now and then, whether you want to level up a new character or want to progress faster on the current season's board. And of course when there is another double EP weekend. Here at Nuka Knights we have compiled all the information for you and have continually updated and improved it since the original post at the beginning of 2020 (in the FB group).

**TLDR: The optimal combination for XP buffs can be found in the section: "Best Max. XP Buffs" below.**

## BASICLY, YOU SHOULD KNOW AND CONSIDER A FEW THINGS TO BE EFFECTIVE:

- 
**Intelligence** affects the XP received (the higher, the better per intelligence point**+2,072% XP** )
 - Armor with an intelligence boost makes sense. Preferably a complete **Unyielding** set.
 - **Berry Mentats** (+ INT)
 - Herbivore: **Brain Bombs** (+ INT), **Brain Mushroom Soup** (+ INT) or alternatively e.g. **Drawn Tato Flower Tea** (+ INT)
 - Carnivore: **Grilled Branbeast Brain** (+ INT)
 - **Power Armor: Helmet with Database** modding also increases intelligence
 - **Mutation: Egghead**  +6 INT
- Armor with an intelligence boost makes sense. Preferably a complete one 
- 
So you get more XP with Relentless armor than with Power armor because you get more intelligence.
- 
**Perk Loadouts**: Skill up to **INT 15** for double XP weekends, for example, to farm maximum XP**+legendary intelligence to 5**
- 
Before leveling, lie down with your character until you get the status " **Well Rested** " (+5% XP for 2 hours)
 - 
With some **Allies** you will receive a longer "Rested Bonus" e.g. with Raider Point you will receive "Kindred Soul" for **3 hours** with +5% XP.
- 
- 
**Cranberry Sauce** and Cake provide XP boost, but require a certain amount of effort to produce. If you don't have much time, start leveling straight away instead of cooking first (For herbivore mutation)
- 
**Canned meat** also provides an XP boost and does not need to be cooked (+5% XP for one hour). Can be obtained from Mama Dolces in the “Feeding the Hungry” event. (5% without mutation, 10% with carnivore mutation, 12.5% with carnivore/Dozen strange and mutated team)
- 
**Leader Bobbleheads** also provide an XP boost (+5% for 1 hour or 2 hours with "Curator" under luck)
- 
As a team, you can also equip or share the card " **Inspiring** " to 3 and get +15% XP when you are in a team.
- 
You can also use the **Magazine** "Life & Love #8" if you want to level up in a team. (+5% XP when in a team).~~For **Herbivores** is "Live and Love #3" (more effect from plant-based food) and for **Carnivores** "Hillbilly #6" (more effect from flesh-cooked food).~~ The effects of the two magazines have been changed and can no longer be used for more XP.
- 
There is a **Mothman EP Bonus**. Once you complete the Path of Enlightenment event at the lighthouse, a peaceful Mothman will appear. When you get up close and personal with this Mothman, you will receive the Mothman's Wisdom effect and gain +5% XP for one hour.
- 
When completing the seasonal **Mothman Equinox Event** you can also click on the Mothman at the end and receive the "Wisdom of the Mothman" for 1 hour**+15% XP bonus**
- 
" **Squirrel Stew** " (+10% XP; +25% with Carnivore mutation).
- 
**Lunchboxes** contain a “Very well rested” XP bonus of +25% per piece, a maximum of 4 pieces count with a 100% bonus. If there are more than 4, a new +25% counter is set per lunch box, which is the oldest
